name: b-fac
description: A factory for running real projects with agents: orchestration workflows packaged to work across coding harnesses rather than only inside one.

plugins.name: b-fac
plugins.description: Run a project as an orchestrator driving implementation subagents against a tracked backlog: break work into items, brief agents that work in isolated worktrees, verify what comes back rather than accepting it, and merge through a path that mechanically refuses red checks. GitHub issues by default; a local store where the repo is not yours.
